title: Blessed Be the Unity of God's People

questions.question: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 133:1 (ESV): "Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity!"

questions.question: It is like the precious oil on the head, running down on the what?
Running down on the beard of whom?
Running down on the collar of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 133:2 (ESV): "running down on the collar of his robes!"

questions.question: It is like the dew of what mountain?
questions.explanation: Psalm 133:3 (ESV): "It is like the dew of Hermon,"

questions.question: Which falls on the mountains of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 133:3 (ESV): "...which falls on the mountains of Zion!"

questions.question: For there the Lord has commanded the blessing, life how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 133:3 (ESV): "For there the Lord has commanded the blessing, life forevermore."

questions.question: What is compared to precious oil?
questions.explanation: The goodness and pleasantness of unity is compared to the anointing oil.

questions.question: What is compared to the dew of Hermon?
questions.explanation: The goodness and pleasantness of unity is also compared to the dew.

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 133?
questions.explanation: Psalm 133 Title: "A Song of Ascents. Of David."

questions.question: What type of oil is mentioned?
questions.explanation: Implied by the context of Aaron (High Priest).

questions.question: Why is Aaron mentioned specially?
options: He was the first High Priest anointed
questions.correctAnswer: He was the first High Priest anointed

questions.question: Mount Hermon is located where relative to Zion?
questions.explanation: It is a high mountain in the north, providing abundant dew.

questions.question: What does "there" refer to in "For there the Lord has commanded the blessing"?
questions.explanation: Typically understood as Zion, where the people gather in unity.

questions.question: How many verses are in Psalm 133?

key_verse_text: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity!
